Hi Monica,

Quick request — we have an immediate operational gap on the inference serving team: Samir (senior inference engineer) has accepted an external offer and his last day is 5/7. We urgently need approval to open a replacement hire at the Senior level (IC-4) so recruiting can start scheduling interviews and sourcing right away.

Key bullets:
- Role: Senior Inference Engineer (serving/runtime)
- Justification: critical ownership of production KV cache and quantized model rollout for a major customer (Acumen Health). Risk to SLOs if left unfilled.
- Target comp band: $200k–$240k OTE (see attached comp analysis)
- Impact if delayed: potential throughput regression risk during Q3 model rollout; will require redistributing on-call and delaying a planned migration project.

I've attached the updated JD and the comp band analysis. Can you route for headcount gate approval and list any additional artifacts you need? Prefer to have approval by EOD 4/13 so recruiter can book interviews for late April.

Thanks —
Marissa

- Cost center: ENG-OPS-02 (product infra cost center), annualized burden ≈ $320k (salary + benefits + hiring tax) — see comp sheet for breakdown.
- Level: Senior / IC-4. Approved by me as hiring manager; I am requesting Vivek's final headcount sign-off (cc'd). No comp override required if we stay within band.
- Candidates: BrightPath has two engaged candidates; internal referral (Aaron Li) is in take-home stage — I copied Aaron's email to Monica for calendar outreach.

Proposed interview plan (to start once headcount opens):
1) Recruiter screen (30m)
2) Hiring manager screen (30m)
3) System design + inference deep-dive (90m)
4) Onsite loop (4 x 45m) + manager sync (30m)

If approved today I can commit to having initial screens scheduled w/in 5 business days.
